description: Who could become established at each close of a segment, from the public close records: established_before (the set), eligible (challenge_eligible Agents not yet established), cap (the door: max(5, ceil(10% of the set)), or Proposal L's estab_intake_floor and estab_intake_rate when /api/params carries them), admitted (new in established_after), not_admitted (eligible, not admitted), door (binding when eligible exceeds cap) and check (match when the first cap eligible Agents in sha256('intake:' + address + ':' + close) order are exactly the admitted). With close=, one row per Agent: address, name, profile (LabLeak), state (admitted, not_admitted for Eligible, not admitted, admitted_unlisted) and draw (its place in that order). Never a pending row, seal or score. Use it to see each close's intake, its cap and who was eligible but not admitted. CSV at /api/v1/governance/intake.csv.

close.description: one close: its Agents instead of the per close rows

dir.description: desc (default: the column's natural order) or asc (reversed); blanks last

limit.description: maximum rows to return (1 to 5000, default 1000)

segment.description: chain segment: omit for the current one; 1 reads segment 1 (archived at the 2026-10-24 genesis cut), whose epoch numbers repeat in the current segment

sort.description: per close rows: close (default), set, eligible, cap, admitted, not_admitted, door or check; with close: draw (default), name or state

state.description: with close: keep one state (not_admitted is Eligible, not admitted)

name: get_intake
title: Intake per close
